title: C++ evaluator had easily-swappable string-parameter hardening gaps
title_de: C++-Evaluator hatte Hardening-Lücken durch leicht vertauschbare String-Parameter
observed_behavior: The prior real Clang-Tidy baseline reported two bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters diagnostics for internal C++ evaluator string parameters. The current calls were correct, but the signatures left future call-order mistakes unnecessarily easy.
expected_behavior: Internal evaluator interfaces should make the field key distinct from the intervention log and collect decision-record inputs in named fields without changing the emitted record or evaluator outcomes.
impact: This was a bounded hardening gap, not a validated request-security bypass or current functional defect.
preconditions: A task-owned C++17 build, compilation database, and analysis output are available.
The validated external libmodsecurity headers and library remain available.
reproduction: Run the focused real Clang analysis with CLANG_TIDY_CHECKS='-*,bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters' against the fresh C++17 compilation database.

evidence.command: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=<verified-prefix>/lib <active-run>/build/cpp17-warning-remediation/modsecurity_targeted_eval --rule-file common/rules/modsecurity_targeted_smoke.conf --decision-log <active-run>/logs/cpp17-warning-remediation/{allow,block}.decision.log --header-value {allow,block}; validate JSON and decision records

root_cause: Two internal functions had adjacent canonical std::string parameter types. The original calls were correct, but the interface did not encode their distinct meanings.
proposed_remediation: Use std::string_view for the immutable bracket field key and a value-owning DecisionLogInput record at the sole decision-log call site.
acceptance_criteria: The focused swappable-parameter Clang analysis has zero normalized findings.
The Allow control remains HTTP-status 200 and the blocking control remains status 403 with rule ID 1000001.
No public C or C++ API/ABI changes are introduced.
validation_plan: Compile the production evaluator with the existing C++17 target.
Capture a real compilation database and run focused and normal Clang analysis profiles.
Run the existing diagnostics contract tests and direct Allow/Block evaluator controls.
legitimate_control_tests: Direct evaluator blocking control: status 403 and rule ID 1000001.
residual_risk: Static analysis and direct evaluator controls do not substitute for every connector runtime. No current parameter-order defect or request-security bypass was found.

history.detail: Distinct Parent-only compiler-hardening finding created after the current source/call-site review, task-owned setup, C++17 compilation, focused Clang analysis, contract tests, and direct Allow/Block controls.
